content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-restraint language exists anywhere in the agreement — this matches our preferred position exactly.

input.quote: 5. PERSONNEL. Each party agrees to assign one (1) existing sales or marketing employee primarily dedicated to assist in the sales and marketing promotional activity set forth in this Exhibit D.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "recruit" and "employ" return no restrictive covenant anywhere in the agreement. The only personnel-related provisions are Section 13 (Shared Resources — Commerce One personnel access and Employee NDA/Invention Agreement warranties), Section 14.5 (Independent Contractors) and Exhibit D Section 5 (each party dedicates a sales/marketing employee); none restricts Corio from soliciting, hiring or employing Commerce One personnel. This satisfies the preferred position (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so no redline is warranted. Nothing to note as a fallback compromise.
